name: try-self-approve
description: round 33: a rule with `proposer: true` is valid only on the check-only action `vcs.try` and nothing else on it; under it the proposal itself satisfies E3, so a claim needs and consumes no approval (the claim records none), nobody's approval is asked, and relevantActors pins no candidate; it never applies to another action (a `*` rule listed first shadows it; vcs.land, a revert and git.push still need their approvals), E1, E2 and the guards of P-15 are unchanged, and a change summary on a vcs.try is invalid
